content: E32-900T30D (EBYTE, SX1276-based, 900-931MHz, 30dBm): 512-byte internal buffer; while AUX=1 user can input <512 bytes continuously without overflow; auto sub-packing occurs when buffer not empty. Air rates 0.3-19.2kbps configurable; 9.6kbps is a standard option (project default per e32_lora.h enum but never written to module - factory default presumed). Single-packet wireless transmission time limited to ~4s at a given rate. 240-byte packet at 9.6kbps = 200ms payload time + preamble overhead.
